seed_health_check_data: seed the litellm health check table with benchmark test data using configurable row count and batch size
benchmark_health_checks: run a benchmark of get_all_latest_health_checks to measure query latency and memory usage
cleanup_benchmark_data: delete all benchmark seed rows from the health check table using the seed marker
build_test_batch: build a batch of synthetic health check rows with model names, status, and timestamps for testing
measure_rss_memory: measure the process RSS memory usage in KiB by reading /proc/self/status on Linux
